title: BOS-877 session list — a transient draft-PR failure reads as a retrying network condition, while a terminal one still shows its raw error

scenes.title: the fix — a draft-PR create that failed against a flapping remote renders as 'PR retrying — GitHub was unreachable' instead of a truncated SSH error

steps.caption: Home session list loaded: the session whose background draft-PR create hit a flapping GitHub

expect.label: the hint sub-row names the retry rather than truncating the transport error (no row title contains these words)

steps.caption: The transient hint states the condition — a retry is under way — instead of pasting a raw SSH failure onto the row

expect.label: the hint names the real cause: GitHub, not the operator's SSH key

steps.caption: This is the sentence that stops an operator hunting through ~/.ssh for a key bug that does not exist

scenes.title: the contrast — the terminal row directly beneath still shows its raw 'Permission denied' error, so the two cases are distinguishable in one frame
